text_block_list.text:
I ended up getting to observe Daitaku 
Helios's dance lessons. I was sure she was 
having fun with it, but—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha! So hard!! Being 'elegant' is 
tough~!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You nailed that move perfectly~~! So why 
are all the other moves such a disaster?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see! She seems to struggle with 
calmer dances, so I've been teaching her 
that, but—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Man, mega sorry!! The vibe was kinda off, 
and it just went in one ear and straight 
runaway out the other~.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't it all about the vibe now? We 
just gotta match the vibe, right!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? If that was all it took, nobody 
would have any trouble!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, hold up☆ My potential is 
seriously insane, you know!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Once you get the groove down, it's smooth 
sailing! For now, let's just go with the 
vibe☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So yeah! Audience, Train-pi! What kind of 
vibe gets you all hyped!?
choice_data_list:
Will you get into the groove with a 
demonstration?

Start with an elegant vibe and get hyped 
up!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I see~! In that case, Teio!! Go bust a 
move☆

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Then why don't the two of us try that 
move you were just able to do?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho-ho, ho-ho-ho-hoo?!? Oh, that kind of 
vibe! Okie-dokie on the hill!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! That's the opposite move! You 
can't just copy what you see directly!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh? Did it get tangled? Ahaha☆

Though they clashed at first, their vibes 
gradually began to sync up—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! As for the vibe! I'll 
deliver something super elegant that'll 
make your heart throb!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Like, I wanna do that thing you always 
see! You know, the classic 
asking-for-a-dance move!
choice_data_list: If it's that kind of thing...

text_block_list.text:
Showing the search results on the 
smartphone to Daitaku Helios...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa!! My hype levels are seriously 
through the roof!? I'm so down, count me 
iiin~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...Teio.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Please, won't you dance with me?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: And now——let's dance♪

Perhaps thanks to catching the "vibe," 
Daitaku Helios's dancing improved 
dramatically, and—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayy, ayy, ayy, and...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Finish.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I... I actually did it...?
choice_data_list: Not really the type suited for lessons?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Riiight~☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Once I get your vibe, it's smooth sailing! 
I think I can totally nail this! Thanks a 
bunch, Teio☆

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Going with the flow might be more 
formidable than I thought...

It was an event that left me, once again, 
in awe of Daitaku Helios's potential.
